root_cause: On session #1 (2015-01-05), the first trading session of Tier 1, agent.decide evaluated initial allocation orders. In legacy mode, order sizing used Tiingo's backward-adjusted prices (which reflect future splits/dividends), whereas in causal production mode, order sizing used true point-in-time raw prices. This caused immediate share quantity divergence on the very first execution on 2015-01-06.
